summary: Wrote docs/plans/2026-10-26-P2-two-lanes.md: admission (admit, once-per-kind waiting notes, USAGE_5H via MET usage five_hour), ports, merge lock, lanes-end, rec_count; the re-base rule as git commands; slots, branch deletion, gc's lane passes; record_pr; status/summary/report wording; stub flags and check files 47-51; order and Michael's after-run steps. An Opus review's 7 Important, 9 Minor fixed in the plan.
verified_how: Each of the six steps checked against the plan's sections (§2 step 1, §3 step 2, §4-§6 step 3, §7 step 4, §8/§10 step 5); an Opus subagent checked every claim against the code at fb3cbe8 and its findings were confirmed (run_init fresh already runs the suite, 33's rk check kills $PPID, gc skips branchless worktrees at bin/harness:485, merge-only exits before driver.sh:405's exports) and fixed; check.sh: green, cached for this code tree, 555 tests (docs/plans is outside the key).

dead_ends.tried: a re-base suite as a second "$CHECK" call after run_init fresh
dead_ends.why: run_init fresh already ran the suite and wrote the marker, so the second call prints 'cached'; the plan takes init.out as the evidence

timeout gives the file its own process group (Ctrl-C no longer reaches it) and becomes its parent (33's rk check would read as a timeout); the plan uses setsid plus a watchdog and forwards the runner's stop to each group

discoveries.text: The P1 clamp's check in 45-lanes-run.sh ('MAX_LANES=2 before P2 is noted …') must be deleted with its name line in P2-02; 47-lanes-two.sh replaces it.

From P2-05, every stub run under MERGE_POLICY=auto would open and merge a record PR (a third `pr merge`): the plan sets RECORD_PR=off in tests/lib.sh's base config; five runs write configs without the base (13:234, 13:456, 14:105, 15:355, 23:4).
`harness merge` exits before driver.sh:405 exports HARNESS_T0/HARNESS_DEADLINE/LANE_MAX_SESSIONS, so a merge lane would die under set -u unless that path exports them.
harness merge's v2 closer (driver.sh:319-321) would close the record PR (same head harness/<run>): it must skip the title '<run>: run record'.
The brief's TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT and the 'suite ran <n>x' note are in no feature's steps: the plan puts the first in P2-02 and the second in P2-06.

questions: Under MERGE_POLICY=pr the end-of-queue gc deletes the record branch (record_only, unchanged by the spec), which closes the record PR left for you that same night. Keep that, or should gc keep a record branch while its record PR is open (one gh call per run branch)? Default taken: keep the spec (plan D4/§9).
proposed_changes: P2-02 step 3: 'allocated under the record lock and the box-wide $STATE_ROOT/port.lock' (the record lock is per run; two runs could take one port). Slot 0 keeps the run's port (plan D1).

P2-02 should list the brief's TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT=10m (tests/run.sh, check in 33-suite-runner.sh); P2-06 the '<id>: suite ran <n>x (<s> s) in the session' note and the initializer's 'measured and recorded' line.
P2-04 step 4: the lane gc checks go in 49-lanes-slots.sh, not the gc file (08 and 13 are the two largest check files).
P2-05 step 1: 'the PR head is gone with it' should read 'the PR is closed by its merge; the branch stays for a same-night continue and the end-of-queue gc deletes it' (plan D4).
